entities.summary: Joyce Sombroek is a former Dutch field hockey goalkeeper of the Netherlands national team. Her international debut was on June 29, 2010 and in total she played international 117 matches. With the Dutch national team Sombroek won every title a professional field hockey player can win. Her biggest achievements are the gold medal at the 2012 Summer Olympics, silver medal at the 2016 Rio de Janeiro and winning the 2014 Women's Hockey World Cup in The Hague. In both Olympic semi-finals Sombroek played an important role by stopping multiple shoot-outs and leading her team into the finals.
